root_idea.summary: The root centers on emptiness, vacancy, and available capacity, with related uses involving release from occupation and pouring out what a vessel contains.
root_idea.development: From the idea of being empty or having room, the root develops into becoming free from work, directing oneself to an object once free, pouring or casting contents outward, and describing breadth, spaciousness, or unhindered movement.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Presented under the normalized active-participle citation form فَارِغٌ.

senses.definition: To become free from an occupation or affair; to finish or have completed it.
senses.usage_conditions: Used with مِنْ for becoming free from or finishing something, and in the construction إِذَا فَرَغْتَ for being finished with an undertaking.

senses.definition: To turn one's attention exclusively to someone or something; to make it one's immediate object.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic construction سَنَفْرُغُ لَكُمْ, the expression is figurative and means to direct oneself exclusively to the addressed parties for reckoning and requital.

senses.definition: To pour or cast a liquid or other substance out, onto, or into a receptacle or object.
senses.usage_conditions: The physical construction includes pouring water or blood and casting molten material into a mold; the Quranic occurrences include both material pouring and casting.

senses.definition: To pour or bestow patience upon someone, so that it envelops and sustains them.
senses.usage_conditions: A figurative use with عَلَى; patience is conceived as something poured over or sent down upon the recipient.

senses.definition: Empty or vacant; of the heart or mind, emptied of ordinary composure or other concerns and left dominated by one overriding concern.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic description of Moses's mother, the heart is variously explained as devoid of patience or anxiety, or as containing nothing except remembrance of Moses; these are contextual interpretations of an emotionally emptied state.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become empty, vacant, void, devoid, or unoccupied; to be available or left open for someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes descriptions of a thing becoming vacant and the construction فَرَغَ لَكَ الشَّيْءُ, in which something is available exclusively for another.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To die, as the body becomes devoid of its soul.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative use said of a person.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of water, to pour or flow forth.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Said of water that becomes poured out or issues forth.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a horse, to be easy, good, and quick in pace, with a wide step.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized description of a horse's spacious and unhindered movement.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Wide, especially of a wound made by a stroke or blow.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative extension from the breadth of a bucket's pouring outlet.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Impatience, disquiet, disturbance, or agitation.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A lexical noun associated with فَرُغَ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To empty or make a thing void or unoccupied.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes making a receptacle empty and a reported Quranic reading in which hearts are made void of fear; this Form II reading is not a separate canonical QAC form group in the packet.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To free someone from business or employment so that they can devote themselves to another matter.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The object is a person who is released from an occupation or left at leisure for a specified purpose.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To address someone with words that leave him confounded or perplexed by shame.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative construction with عَلَيْهِ ذَنُوبًا, literally likened to pouring a bucketful upon someone.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To ejaculate or emit semen during sexual intercourse.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized bodily use with عَلَى at intercourse.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To free oneself from occupation and devote oneself exclusively to a matter.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes becoming unemployed or at leisure, applying oneself to worship or another affair, and confining oneself exclusively to it.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To pour water over oneself or pour water out for oneself.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction may describe taking water and pouring it upon oneself or preparing it for one's own use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To draw out or remove the contents of a vessel.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of extracting water or other contents from a water-skin or vessel.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To induce vomiting or vomit intentionally.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional medical usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To exhaust or use up completely, including taking an entire available portion or exerting one's power to the utmost.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of consuming all that is in a bowl or vessel and figuratively of expending one's effort without reserve.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Width, breadth, or spaciousness.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A noun of breadth and ample extent.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The outlet or pouring side of a leathern bucket, where water issues between its wooden cross-pieces.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized vessel term; its plural forms also designate the corresponding outlets.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The two lunar mansions known as the two Farghs, or the associated pairings of stars.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical astronomical term for the twenty-sixth and twenty-seventh lunar mansions.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A vessel containing date syrup or a similar expressed juice.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized container noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Land affected by drought or barrenness.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized description of unproductive ground.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In vain, without consequence, retaliation, or compensation.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: In the expression ذَهَبَ دَمُهُ فِرْغًا, said of blood whose claim is not pursued and for which no compensation is obtained.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Lost, gone away, or left as though it were absent.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reported Quranic reading concerning the heart of Moses's mother; the reading is preserved here under its own headword because it is not the canonical QAC nominal group.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Made empty or rendered void; of a vessel, emptied, and in a reported reading, of a heart emptied of patience or anxiety.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A passive or resultative adjective; the Quranic reading is distinct from the canonical active-participle form فَارِغٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a bow, without a string or, according to one explanation, without an arrow.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized description of an unequipped bow.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A wide or capacious vessel.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal vessel use distinct from the astronomical plural-like term.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Emptiness, vacancy, freedom from business, or cessation from an affair.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used both as an abstract noun and as a verbal noun associated with becoming free or finishing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A privy or latrine.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A fixed compound expression.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A large bowl or capacious vessel, including a large watering trough or a vessel of any kind.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term may refer specifically to a great bowl that is difficult to carry or to a hide watering trough.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An udder.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized anatomical noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Half of a camel's load, the portion carried on one side.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A dialectal usage attributed to the Tayyiʾ dialect.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Valleys or torrent-beds.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used as a plural-like geographical term.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Broad arrowheads; also a bow whose arrowhead makes a wide wound or whose arrow travels far.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized archery use involving breadth, range, or the effect of the arrowhead.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A she-camel without a brand or hot-iron mark.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized epithet for a she-camel.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A she-camel with abundant milk and an ample udder.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized animal description.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A bow whose arrowhead makes a wide wound or whose arrow travels far.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized bow description; the related broad-arrowhead use is separately recorded under the same lexical family.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Broad or wide; hence, of a wound or spear-thrust, wide and allowing blood to flow.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The adjective applies to broad physical effects and to a wide wound or piercing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A capacious leathern water-bag that can contain much water.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative extension from breadth or spacious capacity.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of land, level or flat, broad, and marked by much treading.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized description of open, even ground.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Wide-stepping, easy, good, or swift in movement.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to a horse or ass and also to a man, without restricting the term to one animal class.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Sharp, of an arrow or knife; figuratively, sharp-tongued, of a man.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The figurative human use describes incisive speech.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A man's semen.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized anatomical noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Empty, vacant, void, or free from business; of speech, empty or nonsensical.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applies to vessels, people free from occupation, and figuratively to empty talk. أَفْرَغُ is the comparative or superlative form, meaning more or most empty or free; the feminine and synonymous pointer forms add no separate branch.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A place or part from which something is poured, especially the part of a leathern bucket next to the front of a watering trough.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized place noun associated with pouring.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The flowing or running of water.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A verbal-noun-like use associated with water issuing forth.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Cast or poured into a mold; by extension, solid and continuous, as a ring without a break.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to cast metal and figuratively to a continuous ring whose sides have no cut.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A she-camel with much milk.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized animal description.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a horse, exhausting its running power without reserving any for later.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative animal description of expending one's full capacity.

cautions: Several Lane entries preserve alternative Quranic readings under Form II or under the nouns فِرْغٌ and فُرُغٌ; these are recorded as separate lexical evidence because the supplied canonical QAC groups contain only Form I, Form IV, and فَارِغٌ.
The Lane Quran citations in the evidence use historical citation notation; modern verse locations in the examples are used only where independently supplied by QAC.
